senses.gloss: to surround, cut off. Denom. כֶּרֶם, כַּרְמְלִית, כַּרְכּוֹם II.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 23:4">Kel. XXIII, 4</cite> the washer’s chair <he>שהוא כוֹרֵם עליו את הכלים</he> (ed. Dehr. <he>כּוֹרֵס</he>) upon which he piles the clothes (to press them); <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 2:9">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. II, 9</cite> <he>שמוכרין</he> ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. <he>שמוכרים</he>, read: <he>שכּוֹרְמִ׳</he>); <cite ref="Shabbat 88b:4">Sabb. 88ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>כרמי עין גדי</he> <cite ref="Song of Songs 1:14">Cant. I, 14</cite>) <he>עון גדי שכָּרַמְתִּי לי וכ׳</he> the guilt of the kid (= golden calf; oth. opin. <cite ref="C00191"><he>גַּדִּי</he></cite> the idol Gad) which I piled (stored up) for me (for future punishment).

Ib. מאי … כרמי לישנא דמכניש הוא (Ms. M. כרם … דמכמש, Ms. O. דמכבש, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) what evidence is there that the word Kerem has the meaning of gathering (or of pressing, preserving)?—Answ. (by ref. to Kel. l. c.) שכּוֹרְמִים עליו את הכלים.

senses.gloss: to cover, paint, v. כְּרוּם, כַּרְכּוֹם I.—[Tosef. Men. IX, 10 וכורמין Var., v. כָּמַר.]
